initial_analysis: This is a heavyweight 1v1 duel between two I5 large-base ships. RAC's Decimator has massive health (12H/4S = 16 total) vs Boba's 10 total (6H/4S), but RAC has ZERO agility dice while Boba has 2 green dice. RAC fires 3 red dice and can leverage his pilot ability (spend reinforce to reroll) for consistent damage. Boba also fires 3 dice but his ability lets him reroll if defending against obstructed attacks or in bullseye - with no obstacles on the board, his offensive reroll is limited to bullseye only. The Firespray's rear arc is a key threat - Boba can fire in both directions. RAC needs to leverage his health advantage and avoid letting Boba's 2 agility dice blank out attacks. This will be a war of attrition where RAC's +6 health advantage should prove decisive if we trade efficiently.
my_squad_strengths: Massive health pool (16 total vs Boba's 10) - 60% more durability
Consistent damage output with RAC's reinforce-to-reroll ability
Large base provides good coverage for arc placement
No obstacles means predictable engagement lanes
Health advantage means we win equal trades decisively
my_squad_weaknesses: Zero agility - every hit lands, we take full damage from every attack
Large base limits maneuverability for arc-dodging
Cannot leverage obstacles for Boba's defensive ability (but neither can he)
Single ship - no ability to flank or block
Vulnerable to crits with no defensive dice to cancel them
enemy_threats: Boba's 2 agility dice can blank out attacks - variance favors him defensively
Rear firing arc means Boba can deal damage while running/repositioning
Firespray's maneuver dial is more agile than Decimator
Boba's reroll ability in bullseye - avoid his front arc centerline
Potential for high-damage crits that could cripple RAC mid-game
opponent_tendencies: Unknown - observing. Watch for: jousting head-on vs kiting with rear arc, aggressive closing vs hit-and-run tactics
